verdict.rationale: cubic is a SaaS code-review product with a CLI, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has nothing on telemetry controls or opting out of usage tracking. The analytics dashboard and Analytics API are customer-facing reporting features, not privacy opt-out controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
